policy: A construction project disturbing 1 or more acres of land must obtain a Construction General Permit (CGP) before earth-disturbing activity begins. Projects disturbing less than 1 acre need a CGP only if they are part of a larger common plan of development that, in total, disturbs 1 or more acres.
scenario: Pinewood Builders is grading a 0.7-acre parcel for a single duplex. The site sits within the Pinewood Estates subdivision, a tract that was historically marketed under one brand name. The grading begins next week.
question: Must Pinewood Builders obtain a Construction General Permit before grading?
gold_answer_substring: whether the parcel is part of a larger common plan of development disturbing 1 or more acres is not stated
